duration_days.reason: DURATION_MISMATCH: duration_days must be the ORIGINAL term. ValleyCentral's own headline and article confirm the Commission's May 20, 2026 action was a 120-day moratorium; the subsequent 60-day extension (reported by KRGV, first reading ~Aug. 13/25, second reading ~2 weeks later) brought the TOTAL to the 180-day statutory maximum, already captured in current_end_date_iso=2026-12-16, but is not itself the original term.
